messages:
liam: flagging an uptick of short SSE sessions after the last proxy canary. clients reconnect every ~600ms a few times then drop. noticed during our synthetic streaming smoke tests.

release-bot: Release event: 2026-03-21T02:40:15 - edge-proxy v1.4.2 promoted to canary pool 3 by @release-oncall.

liam: repro harness: a simple server that emits a single '\n' every 400ms shows the connection closed after ~2s through the proxy. direct server -> client stays open.

tess: dug into proxy changelog  1.4.2 changed write coalescing. previously small writes triggered immediate writev, now we buffer up to 50ms or 64B. seems to break implicit newline heartbeats.

infra-aaron: tcp traces show FIN followed by RST in some cases. suggests upstream closed then proxy reset socket. could be idle-detection hitting because the flush was delayed.

metrics-team: our active_sse_sessions gauge increments on socket_open and decrements on graceful_close. if the proxy RSTs the connection we miss the decrement and the gauge spikes then quickly falls as the reconnects open new sockets. we should derive a liveness metric from heartbeat events rather than relying only on explicit close.

console-amy: I can add a short-session metric (duration < 3s) and a canary vs prod comparator on the dashboard. also will add a draggable annotation for the rollout window.

liam: ops decision needed: pause global rollout?

infra-aaron: pausing is safer until we ship a fix. mitigation options: revert to 1.4.1 on canary nodes or enable per-route immediate-flush flag for text/event-stream endpoints.

tess: quick patch: if request header content-type indicates SSE or Transfer-Encoding: chunked, skip coalescing for writes that are only newline or <8 bytes. implementing as a config flag so ops can toggle. PR incoming.

release-bot: Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/493 by @tess. Includes unit/integration test that simulates periodic 1-byte heartbeats.

metrics-team: added a short-session alert: when short_sse_sessions rate doubles over baseline for 10m -> Sev2. Also instrumented sample of raw socket closes tagged by route and release.

console-amy: dashboard panel added. will auto-tag the canary group on the visualization.

liam: verified on canary with the per-route flag enabled: synthetic client sees stable stream; short-session rate back to baseline.

infra-aaron: recommend rolling the patch to canary group 3 then monitor 30m before promoting. also add audit to check websocket ping frames behavior (similar tiny frames).

tess: opened follow-up ticket: audit coalescing across ws and sse paths -> PROJ-1208.

liam: thanks team. hold on global rollout for now. once patch is validated we can promote and then update runbook to include SSE-specific config for future coalescing experiments. :thumbsup:
